Andes Retreat — Luxury Mountain Escape Landing Page

requirements.description: High-impact visual headline, tagline, and primary reservation CTA button promoting luxury mountain retreat in Antioquia.
Exclusive cabin stay, eco-luxury amenities, mountain views, and personalized hospitality overview.
Semantic grid displaying private Jacuzzi, fireplace, gourmet breakfast, high-speed Starlink Wi-Fi, and guided trails.
Transportation details from Medellín/Jardín with interactive map placeholder and travel guidance.
Direct WhatsApp / Email booking inquiry CTA with date selector and guest capacity form.
Built natively with Astro 7.2.0 components, zero client JS overhead, semantic HTML5, responsive CSS, WCAG AA accessibility, and meta SEO.
